description:
Operating Area: Naples, Italy, Riposto, Sicily

Custom Line Navetta 33 SOUTH is the semi-displacement yacht that turns true sophistication into absolute luxury. Her bow assures best-in-class stability and seaworthiness.

Inside, the areas dedicated to the family and their guests open up on all 3 decks, from the wide-body Master suite forward on the main deck to the 4 guest cabins below. She accommodates up to 11 guests. The light-filled salon comes with a formal dining area.

The Upper deck offers complete privacy and features a dining table, grill, and a large sofa. The sun deck features a Jacuzzi and sun loungers, as well as a conversation area with a comfortable sofa and a coffee table. 

SOUTH offers an extensive selection of water toys. The stabilizers ensure that everyone can enjoy the view and the on board experience both while cruising and when at rest. It's no surprise that she is the ideal yacht for a charter in the Mediterranean.

The crew of 7 dynamic and experienced members is ready to make sure that your vacation aboard SOUTH is nothing short of perfection.

She is equipped with Starlink high speed internet.

crew.name: Francesco Puglisi
crew.bio:
Nationality - Italian

Born in the picturesque town of Mazara del Vallo, Francesco comes from a long line of sailors - his deep passion for the sea runs in the family. After graduating from the nautical institute, he began his career in the yachting industry at the age of 19, quickly diving into the world of nautical charters. He started as a deckhand and swiftly rose to the position of First Officer aboard the Ethna, a Ferretti CL 97. During his time on Ethna, Francesco honed his professional skills and developed an exceptional rapport with clients, thanks to several demanding and dynamic charter seasons. In 2020, after logging thousands of nautical miles and successfully completing numerous charters across the Mediterranean, he earned the rank of Captain. Since 2023, Francesco has been at the helm of EOLIA, a Ferretti CL Navetta 26 owned by the same Owner. His leadership and dedication have earned consistent praise from both Guests and Brokers. Thanks to the trust and esteem of the Owner, his colleagues, and his mentor - the former Captain of South - Francesco now proudly commands this prestigious yacht.

crew.name: Niccolò D'Urso
crew.bio:
Nationality- Italian

 *WON THE 2024 MYBA SUPERYACHT CHEFS' COMPETITION*
Chef Nicola will really amaze your taste buds! He is resourceful, passionate about his job and methodical. During his career, he worked as chef for many famous restaurants in Sicily. His experience allows him to create tailor-made menus that thoroughly meet guests’ preferences. Nicola always takes guests through a sensational gastronomic journey in which are included particular recipes from the Sicilian tradition. Handmade bread and pizza are among his strong points, his “Sicilian citrus flavored Cannolo” is a delight. He tries to improve his skills day after day and gives great importance to guests’ opinion, his way of being creates a pleasant atmosphere on board. Nicola looks forward to welcoming you onboard and showing you his mouth-watering dishes. He speaks English and Italian.

crew.name: Davide Atzeni
crew.bio:
Nationality - Italian

Davide is attentive, outgoing, and delighted to be working aboard SOUTH. After earning a bilingual diploma in Italian and Spanish, Davide immediately embarked on a career in the yachting industry as a deckhand with a desire to travel and meet new people from different backgrounds. He is always approachable and keen to ensure your time spent aboard is the best it can be. In his spare time, he enjoys traveling, cycling, and running. Davide is fluent in Italian, English, and Spanish. The crew holds him in the highest esteem because he always does his best in any task he has. Davide looks forward to welcoming you on board.

crew.name: Jeanne Lynne Lozano
crew.bio:
Nationality - Filipina

Jeanne is a kind and skilled person, determination is her strong suit. She has worked on board several yachts, always getting positive feedback. She aims to provide a sought after service to guests, blending knowledge and proactivity. Jeanne believes that hard work and perseverance make the yacht reach its highest standards. Her enthusiastic approach creates a relaxing atmosphere on board, enabling guests to thoroughly enjoy their stay. Jeanne adores making flower arrangements and table decorations that’s why she always makes it with passion and creativity. She is concentrated on guests' welfare and will guarantee the best assistance up to the smallest details. She speaks English fluently.

crew.name: Ma. Corazon Castro
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
FILIPINA

Ma. Corazon Castro's journey into the maritime industry was sparked by her initial studies in the hospitality sector. Her insatiable curiosity to explore new places and immerse herself in diverse cultures eventually led her to the nautical life, where she found her true calling. MC brings her vibrant personality and professionalism to every aspect of her work. With a warm smile and a genuine desire to ensure guest satisfaction, MC embodies the essence of hospitality onboard SOUTH. Her diligence and commitment to excellence, combined with her skills, make her a perfect stewardess.

crew.name: Jeremy Salcedo
crew.bio:
NATIONALITY
FILIPINO

Jeremy is an able seaman with a long experience in the luxury yachting industry. Jeremy's friendly nature and positive attitude make him a joy to be around for guests and crew alike. As a deckhand, he plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of onboard activities and providing exceptional service to our guests. He loves to take guests snorkeling, and exploring the pearls that SOUTH encounters. Jeremy looks forward to welcoming you on board!

crew.name: John Ebit
crew.bio:
Nationality - Filipino 

John brings over five years of hospitality experience, gained both on cruise ships and in the yachting industry. He began his maritime journey as a commis de cuisine aboard a cruise ship, where he developed strong teamwork, communication, and guest service skills in a demanding and fast-paced environment.
After transitioning into yachting as a steward, John quickly adapted to the high standards of luxury service, gaining valuable experience in guest interaction, attention to detail, and vessel presentation. His versatility and commitment make him a reliable and proactive crew member, always ready to go the extra mile to ensure a flawless guest experience.
With a strong work ethic, a professional attitude, and a passion for hospitality, John plays a key role in maintaining the high standards expected on board M/Y SOUTH, contributing to smooth operations and guest satisfaction throughout every charter.
